test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in direct speech.

Harish says that there is going to be a snowfall.

options.text: Harish says, “There may be a snowfall.”
Harish says, “There was going to be a snowfall.”
Harish says, “There is going to be a snowfall.”
Harish says, “There will be going to be a snowfall.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to match the sentence in direct speech is: **Harish says, “There is going to be a snowfall.”**
 
• To change a speech from Indirect to Direct, the Tense is the most important thing to observe.
 
• Here, the subject Harish is placed first. Then the verb is 'says'. It will be same here. After that 'there is going to be a snowfall' will be same.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Harish says, “There is going to be a snowfall.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harish says, “There may be a snowfall.”** is not correct here.
 
• **Harish says, “There was going to be a snowfall.”** is not correct here.
 
• **Harish says, “There will be going to be a snowfall.”** is not correct here.
